trace_module_for_accelerator: trace a PyTorch module with sample inputs to produce an FX GraphModule for accelerator lowering
rewrite_module_ast: rewrite a module's AST to transform untraceable control flow like asserts and raises into traceable FX calls
create_conditional_exception_wrapper: create a ConditionalExceptionWrapper module that conditionally raises a given exception type based on a boolean condition
remove_assertions_from_graph: remove all torch._assert call nodes from a traced FX GraphModule
remove_exceptions_from_graph: remove all ConditionalExceptionWrapper call module nodes from a traced FX GraphModule
